ambiguities.text: The 'first valid signed bls to execution change received for the validator with index' is ambiguous about the scope of 'first' - per node or network-wide
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'first' means per-node: each node tracks which validator indices it has already seen a valid BLS change for locally. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The spec defers gossip topic transitioning to Altair documentation without specifying Capella-specific transition details
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Capella follows the same gossip topic transition mechanics as Altair fork transitions. This needs verification.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wall-clock time used for epoch calculation is reasonably synchronized across nodes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with skewed clocks could accept or reject BLS change messages incorrectly, causing inconsistent gossip propagation.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge valid BLS signatures for bls_to_execution_change messages
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could redirect validator withdrawal credentials to attacker-controlled execution addresses.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers correctly implement fork-versioned serialization and deserialization for block request/response protocols
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Deserialization mismatches could cause nodes to reject valid blocks or accept malformed data.
